manufacturing.summary: LightCarbon is the house brand of a Xiamen carbon-component manufacturer that also provides OEM and ODM development and production.

profile.summary: Xiamen LightCarbon Composite Technology says it was founded in 2012 and designs, engineers, tests and manufactures carbon frames and components in Xiamen. The company reports a dedicated frame factory with around 80 employees and capacity of about 2,000 framesets per month; it sells LightCarbon products directly while also doing OEM and ODM work for other brands.
